concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-002 (adjusted R‑squared ≥ 0.10) is never referenced in the implementation plan. No task validates or records the adjusted R² against this threshold, leaving the criterion untested.

Success Criterion SC-003 (robustness sign‑consistency and p‑value < 0.05 in the high‑engagement subset) is not explicitly addressed. The plan’s robustness task (T022_robustness_check) mentions running the subset but does not state that the sign and significance must match the full‑sample analysis.

Success Criterion SC-004 (all three assumption‑check p‑values > 0.05) is absent from the plan. While FR‑005 and T021_assumption_checks perform diagnostics, the plan never records whether the p‑values satisfy SC‑004 or halts if they fail.
